note: The look of a waygate (ui/play/gate_art.gd, rendering only; docs/GATES.md; checked by GateArt.validate). An arch is 3 tiles wide and 4 tall (48 by 64 pixels) with the passage tile at the bottom middle: two legs on plinths under a ring of old stone, a rune cut for each slot along the ring (silver when whole, dim when worn, a chipped groove when broken, an empty groove when the silver is stripped). Dark, flickering and lit differ in the runes' light and the shimmer in the opening; a ruined gate is cracked and mossy, and a gate that stands in the wilds beside ruins has fallen stones at its feet. Painted once for each state and kept; nothing is random (the cracks follow a hash of the gate's id).
